_about: WHOLE WATERS THAT ARE TIDAL (T212/T166, owner 2026-10-29). Each item here is tidal water along its whole length: the reach run takes every section of it out of every binding after the tributary walk (owner `water:<item_id>`, `reach.outside.tidal_whole_owner`), the tiles leave it off the freshwater map, and the app shows it as tidal water (DFO rules). Authored from the owner's answer; `mark` is the Tidal-tab mark it answers (read-only copy).
